1# Copyright 2026 FlagOS Contributors 

2# 

3# Kunlunxin (XPU) inline log-gamma helpers. 

4# 

5# XPU Triton has no `lgamma` intrinsic (`tl_extra_shim.lgamma` resolves to 

6# `undefined symbol: Unsupported` at xpu3 link time). This module supplies 

7# fp32 inline replacements built on `tl.log` + `tl.sin` (both supported): 

8# 

9# - `_lgamma_pos(z)`: Lanczos g=7 for z > 0 (fastest, use when domain proven). 

10# - `_lgamma_full(z)`: full-domain log|Gamma(z)| using the reflection 

11# identity Γ(z)·Γ(1−z) = π / sin(π z) for z < 0.5. Not exact at negative 

12# integer poles (returns +inf via log(0)); torch.lgamma matches that. 

13import triton 

14import triton.language as tl 

15 

16 

17@triton.jit 

18def _lgamma_pos(z): 

19 x = 0.99999999999980993 

20 x = x + 676.5203681218851 / z 

21 x = x + (-1259.1392167224028) / (z + 1.0) 

22 x = x + 771.32342877765313 / (z + 2.0) 

23 x = x + (-176.61502916214059) / (z + 3.0) 

24 x = x + 12.507343278686905 / (z + 4.0) 

25 x = x + (-0.13857109526572012) / (z + 5.0) 

26 x = x + 9.9843695780195716e-6 / (z + 6.0) 

27 x = x + 1.5056327351493116e-7 / (z + 7.0) 

28 t = (z - 1.0) + 7.0 + 0.5 

29 return 0.9189385332046727 + ((z - 1.0) + 0.5) * tl.log(t) - t + tl.log(x) 

30 

31 

32@triton.jit 

33def _lgamma_full(z): 

34 # For z >= 0.5 evaluate Lanczos directly; for z < 0.5 use reflection: 

35 # log|Gamma(z)| = log(pi) - log|sin(pi*z)| - log|Gamma(1-z)| 

36 # Evaluate both branches unconditionally, then blend with tl.where to 

37 # keep this XPU-safe (no data-dependent control flow). 

38 pi = 3.141592653589793 

39 log_pi = 1.1447298858494002 

40 lg_pos = _lgamma_pos(tl.where(z >= 0.5, z, 1.0 - z)) 

41 sin_val = tl.abs(tl.sin(pi * z)) 

42 lg_neg = log_pi - tl.log(sin_val) - lg_pos 

43 return tl.where(z >= 0.5, lg_pos, lg_neg)
